responsibility: Implements shared utility routines used by multiple Rust builtin macro expanders. The file provides helpers for builtin-name lookup, token and string-literal AST construction, eager nested-macro reinvocation fragments, delimiter/end-token detection for macro parsers, validation and extraction of expanded string literals, generic expression-list parsing from MacroInvocLexer streams, source-relative filename resolution, and file loading for include-style macros.
same_name_distinction: Implements the shared helper routines used by builtin macro expanders, such as token/string construction, eager invocation handling, parser utilities, path resolution, and file loading. Unlike the paired header, this .cc provides the reusable helper logic itself rather than just publishing the support API.
